scope: Current station QA front views paired with source anchors where supported; all poses approximate and no independent recognisability review. Captures are low-resolution software WebGL fixtures, not 1080p acceptance or uninterrupted streaming. Source-map comparisons are separate.

stations.name: Kidderminster
stations.alignment: approximate station anchor only; source pose, camera and date unknown
stations.review: Reviewed current forward/reverse captures and original 0027. The anchor shows a leafy, walled departure corridor; the fixtures show exposed flat surroundings, generic buildings and sparse vegetation. The source pose is farther through the station and cannot establish exact platform/building dimensions. Station frontage, heritage context and departure cutting still require matched views.

stations.name: Blakedown
stations.alignment: approximate station anchor only; source pose, camera and date unknown
stations.review: Reviewed both captures against original 0090. Source has compact open platforms, pale perimeter fencing and dense mature trees; model surroundings are much more open and use repeated shelter/furniture forms. Crossing component orientation remains a known separate failure; these station fixtures do not prove crossing geometry or road identity.

stations.name: Hagley
stations.alignment: approximate station anchor only; source pose, camera and date unknown
stations.review: Reviewed both captures against original 0133. The new covered lattice footbridge, stair flights and separate Brake Lane arch replace the ground-level strip; reverse view shows an open arch and supported access assembly. Source has distinctive purple lattice, pitched station canopies, brick buildings and much denser tree cover. Roof/canopy profiles, proportions, buildings and surroundings still differ; profile/clearance dimensions are inferred and source/game poses differ.

stations.name: Stourbridge Junction
stations.alignment: approximate station anchor only; source pose, camera and date unknown
stations.review: Reviewed both captures against original 0178. Source has broad continuous pitched canopies, substantial station buildings and the branch/bay context; model has narrower flat canopies and repeated furniture in an open generic urban setting. Platform map outlines alone do not certify branch trackwork, canopy span or station identity.

stations.name: Lye
stations.alignment: approximate station anchor only; source pose, camera and date unknown
stations.review: Reviewed both captures against original 0229. Source has small shelters, fencing, foliage and a distinct overbridge at the platform end. Model includes tall generic nearby blocks, repeated long shelter forms and a generic access bridge; station-specific surroundings, overbridge placement and access form remain unresolved.

stations.name: Cradley Heath
stations.alignment: approximate station anchor only; source pose, camera and date unknown
stations.review: Reviewed both captures against original 0247. Source shows a constrained curved station/crossing approach with fencing and overhead access; model shows much broader open platforms and generic surrounding blocks. Crossing-road binding, barriers, buildings and the access structure require site-level reconstruction.

stations.name: Old Hill
stations.alignment: approximate station anchor only; source pose, camera and date unknown
stations.review: Reviewed both captures against original 0272. Source shows leafy curved approaches, tight platform edges and a nearby overbridge. Model uses open surroundings, generic bridge/canopies and sparse vegetation. Cutting profile, bridge composition and station shelter placement are unaccepted; the nearby tunnel requires its own portal/departure views.

stations.name: Rowley Regis
stations.alignment: approximate station anchor only; source pose, camera and date unknown
stations.review: Reviewed both captures against original 0287. Source shows an open railway beneath a road bridge in a dense treed cutting. Current forward fixture shows a pale slab apparently crossing both running lines at low level, while reverse shows a generic footbridge. Treat as a new obstruction candidate requiring actual-triangle ownership/volume diagnosis; the source anchor is an approach, not a surveyed pose.

stations.name: Langley Green
stations.alignment: no securely assigned station photograph
stations.review: Reviewed current forward/reverse model views only. Generic shelters, access bridge and open surroundings are visible. Original 0322 is only a location candidate; no securely assigned station photograph is available, so photographic accuracy is unreviewed and unaccepted.

stations.name: Smethwick Galton Bridge
stations.alignment: approximate station anchor only; source pose, camera and date unknown
stations.review: Reviewed both captures against original 0345. Source clearly shows a layered interchange with structures above an open lower railway. The forward model fixture is apparently blocked by an earth-coloured wall, with rails visually ending at it; reverse is much more open and lacks the distinctive interchange composition. Requires source-owned obstruction diagnosis and a complete two-level station/civil solution; source/game poses are approximate.

stations.name: The Hawthorns
stations.alignment: approximate station anchor only; source pose, camera and date unknown
stations.review: Reviewed both captures against original 0361. Source has substantial overhead concrete structures, long platform coverings and adjacent Metro infrastructure. Model has an open cutting, simple footbridge/shelters and sparse surroundings. Concourse, Metro relationship, overhead spans, canopy extents and retaining forms remain unaccepted.

stations.name: Jewellery Quarter
stations.alignment: approximate station anchor only; source pose, camera and date unknown
stations.review: Reviewed both captures against original 0397. Source shows tightly enclosed platforms, retaining walls, urban frontage and overhead access. Model has generic faceted banks and buildings, an exaggerated tall wall in reverse, and simplified shelter/access forms. Station enclosure, support layers and adjoining Hockley portal relationships need separate reconstruction and clearance checks.

stations.name: Birmingham Snow Hill
stations.alignment: approximate station anchor only; source pose, camera and date unknown
stations.review: Reviewed both captures against original 0423. Source has a detailed enclosed station roof with columns, lighting and platform structures. Current game views show a large dark overhead plane, generic surrounding walls and sparse furniture; reverse has an apparent unsupported/floating small trackside box. Source/game poses and lighting differ; roof/column/support identity and trackside object ownership require diagnosis.

stations.name: Birmingham Moor Street
stations.alignment: approximate station anchor only; source pose, camera and date unknown
stations.review: Reviewed both captures against original 0443. Source has the distinctive enclosed heritage concourse/footbridge and pitched canopies. Forward model emerges from a generic dark bore; reverse shows a large earth-coloured slab across the view near the station end. Exact alignment differs. Heritage station assembly, the slab/opening and tunnel/station transitions remain unaccepted.

stations.name: Bordesley
stations.alignment: no securely assigned station photograph
stations.review: Reviewed current forward/reverse model views only. Raised platforms and generic shelter/building shapes are visible; no securely assigned station photograph is available. Access, viaduct and station identity cannot be accepted from these captures or source map pins alone.

stations.name: Small Heath
stations.alignment: approximate station anchor only; source pose, camera and date unknown
stations.review: Reviewed both captures against original 0487. Source shows an open railway under a dark road bridge, with brick/vegetation surroundings. Forward model has an earth-coloured wall apparently sealing the view below a green deck; reverse is open with generic platforms. Diagnose emitted wall/deck/support ownership and lower-route clearance; photographic alignment is approximate.

stations.name: Tyseley
stations.alignment: no securely assigned station photograph
stations.review: Reviewed current forward/reverse model views only. Model shows multiple mapped platforms, simple canopy and nearby bridge shapes. No securely assigned photograph exists; original 0499 remains only a candidate. Junction/depot context, access and station architecture remain unreviewed against photographs.

stations.name: Acocks Green
stations.alignment: no securely assigned station photograph
stations.review: Reviewed current forward/reverse model views only. Model has a large rectangular bridge frame and simple platforms/shelters. No securely assigned station photograph exists. Bridge/retaining supports, access, buildings and platform details remain unaccepted.

stations.name: Olton
stations.alignment: approximate station anchor only; source pose, camera and date unknown
stations.review: Reviewed both captures against original 0513. Source approach is heavily vegetated and partly backlit, with tight platform-edge surroundings. Model is open, flat and dominated by repeated buildings and furniture. The source does not establish exact canopy dimensions; vegetation, embankment/retaining profile, bridge/access and architecture need additional matched station frames.

stations.name: Solihull
stations.alignment: approximate station anchor only; source pose, camera and date unknown
stations.review: Reviewed both captures against original 0541. This is a platform-side photograph, not a forward-cab pose; it establishes pitched canopy, station building and planting details. Model has open broad platforms, generic flat forms and repeated nearby blocks. Station-specific canopy/roof, buildings, access and planting remain unaccepted; direct pixel alignment would be invalid.

stations.name: Widney Manor
stations.alignment: no securely assigned station photograph
stations.review: Reviewed current forward/reverse model views only. Forward shows broad open platforms and generic surroundings; reverse is almost completely filled by an earth-coloured vertical face near the camera. This is an unresolved obstruction candidate even without a securely assigned station photograph. Determine source-owned geometry and train/road openings before accepting the site.
